evidence.passage: [ACR BI-RADS Category 2: Benign Finding(s)] ACR BI-RADS Category 2: Benign finding(s). Like category 1, this is a normal assessment, but benign findings are described. Includes simple cysts, intramammary lymph nodes, benign vascular calcifications, stable fibroadenomas, and fat necrosis. Malignancy risk is 0%. Management: Routine screening mammography.

[ACR BI-RADS Category 3: Probably Benign] ACR BI-RADS Category 3: Probably Benign finding. Finding has a very high probability (> 98%) of being benign. Malignancy risk is > 0% but <= 2%. Specific findings include non-calcified circumscribed solid mass, focal asymmetry, or cluster of round punctate calcifications. Management: Short-interval follow-up (usually unilateral at 6 months, then bilateral at 12 and 24 months) to establish stability.
